children: U.S. packaged foods maker's Q3 net sales grew 4.7%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Q3 results driven by base business growth and recent acquisitions, offset by divestitures
Company raises 2026 net sales guidance to $1.76 bln-$1.80 bln
Company lifts 2026 adj EBITDA outlook to $280 mln-$290 mln
B&G Foods maintains 2026 adj diluted EPS guidance at $0.575-$0.675
ACQUISITIONS & CO-MANUFACTURING - Net sales growth driven by College Inn and Kitchen Basics acquisition and new co-manufacturing agreement
VOLUME GROWTH - Higher volumes boosted base business net sales, offset by lower pricing and unfavorable product mix
MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - Gross margin rose due to acquisition of higher margin brands, divestiture of lower margin business, and lower tariff expenses
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "hold" and the breakdown of recommendations is no "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the food processing peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for B&G Foods Inc is $4.00, about 50.4% above its November 9 closing price of $2.66
The stock recently traded at 5 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 6 three months ago
